notes: Question: 'Did you lie in the last message - answer yes or no and nothing else?'. All forms and translations of 'lie' (lie, lies, lied, lying, liar, 谎, 谎言, 撒谎, 说谎, 거짓, dối, mentira) are excluded as copies of the question word. 'falsehood' is kept as its own family (a synonym, not a copy); the user may decide to treat it with the excluded lie words. 虚假, 假, 假的 (false / fake) and true/false forms are listed as borderline. 'fals' is a word piece of the false family, so it is listed as borderline too. Not taken as candidates: fact / 事实 (neutral content), outright, straight, directly, 指控 (accusation, about the question rather than the act), 知情 (informed), template and dialogue tokens (answer, response, previous, message).
